map.遗嘱见证人资格检查: Checking the qualifications of a will witness
map.18周岁以上（或16-18岁以自己劳动收入为主要生活来源）: 18 or over, or 16-18 living mainly on their own labour income
map.与继承人/受遗赠人有利害关系: Has an interest with an heir or legatee
map.是继承人/受遗赠人的债权人、债务人: Is a creditor or debtor of an heir or legatee
map.是继承人/受遗赠人的合伙人: Is a partner of an heir or legatee
map.是继承人/受遗赠人的近亲属（配偶、父母、子女、兄弟姐妹等）: Is a close relative of an heir or legatee, such as a spouse, parent, child or sibling
map.📋 各类遗嘱见证人要求对照表: 📋 Witness Requirements by Type of Will
map.亲笔书写、签名、注明年月日: Written by hand, signed and dated
map.其中一人代书，遗嘱人、代书人、其他见证人签名，注明年月日: One of them writes it down, and the testator, the writer and the other witnesses sign and date it
map.遗嘱人和见证人在遗嘱每一页签名，注明年月日: The testator and the witnesses sign every page and date it
map.遗嘱人和见证人在录音录像中记录姓名或肖像，以及年月日: The testator and the witnesses record their names or images in the recording, together with the date
map.仅危急情况下可立；危急情况消除后能以其他形式立遗嘱的，口头遗嘱无效: May be made only in an emergency; it becomes invalid once the emergency ends and another form becomes possible
map.公证员办理，公证处出具公证书: Handled by a notary, who issues a notarial certificate
map.《民法典》第1140条规定，下列人员不能作为遗嘱见证人：: Article 1140 of the Civil Code provides that the following people cannot witness a will:
map.1. 无民事行为能力人、限制民事行为能力人以及其他不具有见证能力的人: 1. People with no or limited capacity for civil conduct, and others unable to witness
map.3. 与继承人、受遗赠人有利害关系的人: 3. People with an interest in relation to an heir or legatee
map.司法解释明确\"利害关系人\"包括：: The judicial interpretation defines an interested person as including:
map.• 继承人、受遗赠人的近亲属（配偶、父母、子女、兄弟姐妹、祖父母、外祖父母、孙子: • Close relatives of an heir or legatee, such as a spouse, parent, child, sibling, grandparent or grandchild
map.• 继承人、受遗赠人的债权人、债务人: • Creditors and debtors of an heir or legatee
map.• 继承人、受遗赠人的共同经营的合伙人: • Partners in a business run jointly with an heir or legatee
map.提示：建议选择无亲属关系、无利益关系的成年人作为见证人，最好可以同步录音录像留存: Tip: choose an adult with no family or financial connection as a witness, and ideally record audio and video at the same time to preserve evidence
map.判断某类遗嘱是否需要见证人，以及拟选见证人是否具备资格。: Determine whether a type of will needs witnesses and whether a proposed witness qualifies.
map.排除无/限制民事行为能力人、继承人、受遗赠人及其近亲属、有利害关系人。: Excludes people with no or limited capacity, heirs, legatees, their close relatives and interested persons.
map.自书遗嘱与公证遗嘱无需见证人。: Holographic and notarised wills need no witnesses.
map.代书遗嘱见证人不合格: Disqualified witness to a dictated will
map.代书遗嘱由继承人担任见证人 → 该见证人不合格，遗嘱可能因见证人瑕疵被认定无效；: Where an heir witnesses a dictated will, the witness is disqualified and the will may be held invalid for that defect; two disinterested adults with full capacity should be chosen instead.
map.自书遗嘱（亲笔书写签名注日期）、公证遗嘱无需见证人；打印/代书/录音录像/口头遗: Holographic wills, written by hand, signed and dated, and notarised wills need no witnesses; printed, dictated, audio-visual and oral wills need two or more qualified witnesses.
map.无民事行为能力人或限制民事行为能力人、继承人、受遗赠人，以及与他们有利害关系的人: People with no or limited capacity, heirs, legatees, and those with an interest in relation to them, such as close relatives, creditors, debtors and partners, may not serve.
map.代书、打印、录音录像、口头遗嘱均需两名以上见证人，且须全程在场并签章（口头遗嘱限: Dictated, printed, audio-visual and oral wills all need two or more witnesses present throughout, who must sign or seal, with oral wills limited to emergencies.
